description: Two US job offers, each a pay figure in a state or one of the 50 largest metro areas, compared after federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare and state income tax, then after local prices (BEA regional price parities, rent included). Returns take-home pay, take-home at national prices, which offer is worth more and by how much, and the salary each place would need to match the other. With a job, also where each offer sits on the official pay distribution. City and county income taxes are not included.

a_place.description: Offer A's place: a US state or large metro area.

job.description: Optional job title or slug, to place each offer on the official distribution.

unit.description: year or hour, for both offers (default year).

name: compare_offers
title: Compare two US job offers
